title: Area Border Router Not Generating Summary Routes
symptoms: Backbone area routers do not see a summarized route for the branch office
The ABR has all the branch subnets in its database
Branch office routers see their own subnets fine
Manual route injection into the backbone has never been needed before
rootCause: The 'area X range' command was configured for the wrong area. The summary is being generated for Area 0 (backbone) instead of for the branch area. Backbone routers never receive the summary because the ABR didn't actually originate it into Area 0.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the OSPF configuration including area ranges?
steps.hint: Look for 'area X range' statements - verify the area number matches the branch area.

steps.prompt: Which command shows what the ABR is advertising to Area 0?
steps.hint: If the summary LSA is missing, the range command isn't working.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the routing table on the ABR to verify the summarized route exists locally?
steps.hint: Look for an 'O IA' summary route - its absence confirms the misconfiguration.
